rationale.coroutines: Captures and borrowed parameters can outlive invocation frames; hostile RAII may cross a suspension.
rationale.move: Moved JSON, owning coroutine state and forwarding wrappers need explicit lifetime analysis.
rationale.optional: Untrusted parser results use optional; unchecked reads can fail on malformed input.
rationale.dangling: String and regex match handles borrow JSON and input storage.
rationale.clang-analyzer-*: Installed non-debug path-sensitive checks cover null, bounds, uninitialized, heap and resource paths.
rationale.performance: Only inexpensive copy/move checks; no broad style or pedantic groups. Findings remain individually classified.

suppression_policy: No broad suppression or accepted baseline. Exact false-positive fingerprints require original diagnostics and matching compiler/header/check identities.
